title: Live!
artist: Fela Ransome-Kuti and the Africa '70 with Ginger Baker

drum_performances.name: Ginger Baker
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Baker sitting in with Fela's band; recorded 1971, released on Regal Zonophone.

drum_performances.name: Tony Allen
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Fela's drummer and co-architect of afrobeat, recorded live in 1971 with Baker sitting in; Black Man's Cry carries his first pattern with a floor tom answering like a conga.

ev.note: Which drummer leads on each track not confirmed.
